title: Fastest object vs. fastest a human has ever traveled (mph)

source.name: Spaceflight speed records: Apollo 10 and Parker Solar Probe

notes: Illustrative -- real published NASA figures formatted for narration. Apollo 10's 1969 reentry speed of 24,791 mph remains the fastest speed any human has personally traveled; Parker Solar Probe's December 2024 record of 430,000 mph is roughly 17x faster.
